mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4; armodafinil may inhibit CYP3A4 leading to increased albendazole metabolite concentrations, while albendazole induces CYP3A4 potentially reducing armodafinil levels.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of armodafinil and consider therapeutic drug monitoring; counsel patient on potential reduced wakefulness-promoting effects and need for dose adjustment if co-administration is necessary.
